The value is in assembling what is already available and showing how the pieces relate. Public channels What is posted openly Authorised sources Records you may lawfully use Already available to you Two questions Who is this, and is it genuine Accounts impersonating your people or brand Activity that looks coordinated, not organic Whether records describe one person or several How the connections between them were drawn A lead, not a conclusion Connections are presented with the reasons behind them for an analyst to follow, test and discard, never acted on automatically. A picture of the connections With the reasoning shown A record of what was concluded For a case file or a review 01 Set what you are watching for Name the people, brands or subjects that matter, and the sources you are entitled to draw on. That boundary is set at the start and the work stays inside it. 02 It gathers what is already there Public channels are monitored for impersonation and for activity that looks organised rather than genuine. Records across your authorised sources are collected together for the subject in question. 03 The pieces are related Records that appear to describe the same person are brought together, and the connections between them are shown along with the reasons they were drawn, so a weak link is visible as a weak link. 04 An analyst decides The picture is handed over for a person to examine, follow and challenge. What they conclude is recorded with the material that supported it, in a form suitable for a case file, an escalation or a review. Use cases Where organisations put it to work Wherever the answer is already public but scattered. These are the situations teams bring to the category most often. Banking and financial crime Establish whether applications and accounts held in different systems belong to the same person, and give an investigator the connections behind that view rather than a list of possible matches. Brand and executive protection Find accounts impersonating your senior people or your brand while they are still being set up, and keep a record of each one for a takedown request or legal follow up. Law enforcement and public safety Assemble the publicly available picture around a subject or an incident quickly, with every connection traceable back to what it was drawn from. Insurance Understand whether apparently unrelated claims connect back to the same people, which is difficult to see when each claim is assessed on its own. Trust and safety teams Distinguish coordinated activity from genuine public reaction, so enforcement is aimed at organised behaviour rather than at people who happen to agree with each other. Corporate due diligence Build the public picture of a counterparty before a deal, and hand a reviewer the reasoning rather than a conclusion they have to take on trust. FAQ What people ask about TrustShield OSINT Answered the way an analyst, a security lead or a privacy officer asks them. What is TrustShield OSINT? − TrustShield OSINT is FaceOff's suite for turning information that is already public or already lawfully held into something an investigator can work with. It monitors public channels for accounts impersonating your people and brand and for activity that appears coordinated, and it establishes whether records held across your authorised sources describe the same person. Findings are handed to an analyst with the reasoning attached. Where does the information come from? + From channels that are already public, and from sources your organisation is entitled to use. The boundary is set when the work is configured and the suite stays inside it. Nothing here obtains information by accessing accounts, systems or material you have no right to, and the sources behind any finding are shown so a reviewer can check where it came from. Does it decide anything about a person? + No. It produces leads for a person to examine, not conclusions to act on. Connections are presented together with the reasons they were drawn, precisely so an analyst can test them and discard the ones that do not hold. Decisions about people should be made by people who can be asked to justify them, and the suite is built on that assumption rather than around it. How does it tell coordinated activity from genuine public reaction? + By looking at how accounts and activity relate to one another rather than at what any single account says. Genuine reaction tends to be untidy and independent; organised activity tends to share patterns that individual accounts do not reveal on their own. The distinction is presented as a finding with its supporting material, because getting it wrong means acting against ordinary people. Can findings be used in an investigation or a regulatory submission? + Findings are prepared to be examined. Each connection is traceable back to the material it was drawn from, and what an analyst concluded is recorded alongside the evidence that supported it, so the reasoning can be followed by a colleague, a regulator or a court rather than having to be reconstructed from memory later. Who uses TrustShield OSINT? + TrustShield OSINT is used by financial crime teams resolving whether records describe the same person, corporate security teams protecting executives and brands from impersonation, law enforcement assembling the public picture around a subject, insurers looking for connections between claims, trust and safety teams separating coordinated activity from genuine reaction, and diligence teams researching counterparties. Is a finding ever wrong? + Yes, and the suite is designed on that basis. A connection between records is a reason to look more closely rather than proof that two records describe one person, and public information is frequently incomplete or out of date. That is why every finding carries the reasoning behind it and why the analyst, not the system, reaches the conclusion. content.text: ﻿ Performance Campaigns backed by strong Digital Transformation support for your brand Performance Campaigns backed by strong Digital Transformation support for your brand AI Prototyping AIVaas What we do Customer journey Awareness Consideration Conversion Retention Advocacy Technology Development Blog About us Careers Contact Us AI Prototyping AIVaas Your End-to-End Digital Growth Partner Transforming BFSI Digital Experiences at Every Touchpoint Where MarTech meets FinTech. We bridge the gap between marketing and technology to drive growth, enhance customer experience, and ensure regulatory compliance for Banks, NBFCs, and MFIs. Explore Our Approach See Your Digital Solution Come to Life in 24 Hours— No Strings Attached We transform your business challenge into a working prototype in just 24 hours, helping you validate ideas quickly without significant upfront investment. Get Your Free Prototype What takes weeks elsewhere happens in 24 hours here Orchestrating AI Video Production at Scale We navigate the complexity of AI video tools so you can focus on marketing strategy and results. See how it works Newgen Digital brings structure to the chaos of AI video production. We orchestrate multiple specialized platforms—matching the right technology to each objective. From product demos to always-on social campaigns, we deliver video that performs. Crafting your customer's Digital Journey NDW Marketing Creative Technology @NDW we focus on crafting customer journeys where creative, marketing, and technology all play important roles. Creative handles the design and engagement, marketing promotes the journey and uses customer data, and technology enables the journey and ensures it runs smoothly. 01 Awareness A Framework to measure your awareness campaign 7KPIs for measuring the awareness stage At this stage, your potential customers are aware that they have a specific need or problem they need solving and they usually started researching answers to their questions when they come across your company or website. Our framework will help you audit these key KPIs to track how well you're engaging awareness-stage users to find your site and consider your brand as a possible solution to their pain points. Get in touch to get the framework. View casestudy TECHNOLOGY Website, CMS, Personalisation Media SEO, SMM Creative Content, Social (Platform-centric) 02 Consideration Experience the power of connected marketing. During the consideration stage of the customer journey, businesses can use connected marketing techniques such as providing relevant and helpful content, utilizing social media and email marketing, leveraging search marketing, and showcasing customer reviews and testimonials to build trust, stay top of mind, and encourage potential customers to make a purchase Get in touch to power your Marketing. View casestudy TECHNOLOGY Kiosks, Campaign Integration, EMS, Dealer Integration, CRM Media Performance Marketing, Remarketing Creative Long Format Content (SEO, Benchmarking, Differentiator & Success Rate), Social (Reels & Video Production) 03 Conversion PET (Persuasion, Emotion, Trust) inspired conversions During the conversion stage of the customer journey, a PET-inspired strategy could involve optimizing performance, enhancing the user experience, and leveraging technology to make the purchasing process as smooth and convenient as possible. This can help to increase the chances of turning potential customers into actual customers. Get in touch to take your Customer Experience to the next level. View casestudy TECHNOLOGY E-commerce (Website, Physical Store, App), Payment Gateway, Media Performance marketing, ORM, Creative Hyperlocal communication (Planning & Execution), Transactional communication 04 Retention Personalised Solutions for Maximizing Customer LTV To maximize customer lifetime value (LTV) through personalization during the retention stage of the customer journey, businesses can use customer data to send targeted communications, make personalized product recommendations, create personalized experiences, and offer personalized customer service. This can help to increase customer satisfaction and loyalty, which can lead to increased LTV. Get in touch to Maximise your Customer LTV. View casestudy TECHNOLOGY Website Development, App Development, Loyalty Application Media Email WhatsApp & SMS Campaigns Creative ORM, Customer Engagement 05 Advocacy Grow your Community During the advocacy stage of the customer journey, businesses can focus on building a community of brand advocates by fostering a sense of belonging, encouraging customer feedback and participation, creating opportunities for social interaction, and rewarding advocacy. This can help to increase brand awareness and drive word-of-mouth marketing, attracting new customers. Get in touch to Grow your Community. View casestudy TECHNOLOGY Community Portals, Intranet Platforms Media Emailer, SMS, WhatsApp Campaigns Creative Customer Engagement, UGC Content - Social Tech Enables a Great Digital Customer Journey Technology is essential for creating a digital customer journey that is personalized, convenient, and backed by analytics. It helps businesses understand their customers and provide a high-quality experience that keeps them coming back. content.text: Service Model | FaceOff Technologies | FaceOff Technologies Skip to content India USA Global Free online demo Become A Partner Platform Products Solutions Regulations Resources Company Sign in Request a demo Search Open menu SERVICE MODEL Scalable Protection via On-Prem and SaaS The rapid expansion of artificial intelligence driven fraud requires security platforms to operate not only with high accuracy but also with flexible deployment frameworks capable of serving organizations across industries with diverse regulatory and infrastructure needs. FaceOff is uniquely positioned to meet this demand through its dual delivery model offering both on premise deployments and scalable Software as a Service platforms. This blended approach enables enterprises small businesses and government agencies to adopt advanced synthetic media detection and identity verification technologies without compromising compliance performance or data sovereignty requirements. Engineered to scale across critical industries: • Food Delivery • Ecommerce • Fintech • Healthcare • Education • Recruitment • Utilities • Transportation • Public Governance ON-PREMISE DEPLOYMENT 100% SOVEREIGN Local Customer Data Center / Edge Image & Video Liveness Engines Voice Biometrics & Risk Assessment Zero Raw Data Egress to External Cloud HYBRID UNIFIED BUS SAAS CLOUD DELIVERY INSTANT SCALE Multi-Region Global Inference Instant REST / gRPC API Integrations Central Compliance & Risk Dashboard Continuous Dynamic Model Updates SOVEREIGN AIR-GAPPED INFRASTRUCTURE FaceOff On-Premise Deployment Model On premise deployment allows organizations to host FaceOff’s artificial intelligence engines within their own data centers or secured edge environments. This deployment model is ideal for institutions with strict data localization policies sensitive biometric processing regulations or national security requirements. Data Custody Guarantee All raw image audio and biometric data remain within the customer environment ensuring full ownership and regulatory compliance. Core Local Capabilities: Image authenticity verification and deepfake detection Video liveness analysis and motion authenticity tracking Voice biometric consistency validation Behavioral communication risk assessment Integrated enterprise authentication connectors Industry Adoption for On-Premise Solutions Government Agencies Government agencies use on premise FaceOff for identity verification and citizen authentication while keeping all sensitive data secured within sovereign locations. Healthcare Institutions Healthcare institutions apply FaceOff to protect telemedicine platforms where biometric verification of patients and clinicians must comply with medical data safety regulations. Defense & Financial Institutions Defense and financial institutions deploy on premise FaceOff to secure video communications without routing sensitive data through external cloud processors. Public Sector Recruitment & Exams Public sector recruitment and examination boards utilize onsite FaceOff authentication to block impersonation during interviews and assessments. GLOBAL CLOUD SCALE FaceOff SaaS Delivery Model FaceOff’s Software as a Service solution enables companies to onboard quickly without complex infrastructure investments. This cloud centered service provides instant scalability and usage based commercial flexibility. SaaS Platform Capabilities: Secure API integrations with web applications, mobile systems, and enterprise software Global cloud inference for real-time detection across continents Automated risk scoring for suspicious identity or media submissions Dynamic learning updates improving detection accuracy continuously Centralized dashboards and compliance reporting Industry Scaling Through SaaS Solutions Food Delivery Platforms Verifying refund claims and customer video interactions to prevent synthetic dispute fraud. Ecommerce Enterprises Validating seller identities, merchant onboarding verification, and return dispute resolution. Fintech & Challenger Banks Authenticating high-volume voice and video banking interactions in real time. EdTech Providers Validating test-takers, video interviews, and online proctored examinations. Recruitment & Staffing Preventing candidate impersonation and synthetic profile overlays during remote interviews. BLENDED ORCHESTRATION Hybrid Industry Scaling Architecture FaceOff uniquely supports hybrid scaling by allowing customers to combine SaaS and on premise models to suit operational requirements. Transactional validation tasks can run via cloud SaaS pipelines enabling high volume verification at low operational cost. Mission critical biometric verification for regulated interactions can be routed through on premise engines within secure private networks. Unified risk scoring operates across both platforms presenting customers with a single integrated fraud control interface regardless of deployment model. DEVELOPER-NATIVE Enterprise Scaling Through API-Centric Design FaceOff’s entire service architecture is built around secure APIs that ensure seamless integration with existing technology stacks. This empowers industries to introduce identity verification at points of vulnerability without disrupting customer experience. Customer Dispute Resolution Instantly cross-check flagged transaction evidence and media. Authentication Gateways Secure account recovery, KYC re-verification, and support workflows. Vendor Onboarding Portals Automate merchant identity and business credential validation. Video Conferencing & Tele-Interviews Real-time stream monitoring during high-stakes hiring & board meetings. PRIVACY-BY-DESIGN Compliance-Led Scalability FaceOff uses privacy first service frameworks designed to comply with: Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDP) in India General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) international mandates Health privacy and biometric handling standards Sector-specific security compliance protocols Both SaaS and on premise deployments allow organizations to define data retention controls encryption standards and audit reporting workflows ensuring full regulatory acceptance. HIGH AVAILABILITY Operational Readiness for Large Scale Growth FaceOff will scale sustainably through: Multi regional cloud infrastructure supporting global throughput Automated system load balancers maintaining performance during peak usage Continuous monitoring via artificial intelligence driven reliability engines Rapid model updates responding to emerging deepfake technologies Market Impact of Dual Delivery Strategy Accelerated Adoption Organizations adopt security services faster when deployment barriers are low. SaaS removes entry friction while on premise availability captures heavily regulated institutions which traditionally resist cloud based adoption. Broader Market Reach FaceOff expands beyond typical startup markets into government universities hospitals and financial regulators who demand sovereign deployment capabilities. Cross-Industry Normalization By offering flexible deployment options FaceOff establishes a universal identity verification layer across sectors normalizing authenticated human presence verification as a standard operational safeguard. Building the Future of Digital Trust FaceOff’s dual delivery architecture combining scalable SaaS deployment with fully sovereign on premise installations creates a uniquely adaptable security platform capable of industry wide expansion. This strategy removes regulatory roadblocks accelerates commercial adoption and ensures that both public and private sectors can secure their digital interactions without compromise.
